name: braintrust
summary: I installed the `braintrust` and `autoevals` packages (144 packages added successfully) and created `tutorial.eval.ts` exactly per the README quickstart. However, running `npx braintrust eval tutorial.eval.ts` fails with a `TypeError: fetch failed` caused by `ECONNRESET` when connecting to `api.braintrust.dev`. I confirmed this is a sandbox network restriction: `curl` to `api.braintrust.dev`, `www.braintrust.dev`, and even `www.google.com` over HTTPS all return "Connection reset by peer," while plain HTTP requests go through. No eval run could execute, so the promised outcome of scores being reported was not achieved.

env_ready.evidence: node --version returned v25.9.0 and npm --version returned 11.12.1

installed.evidence: npm install braintrust autoevals reported added 144 packages in 9s

configured.evidence: API Key set: yes and Length: 51, wired via BRAINTRUST_API_KEY="$BRAINTRUST_API_KEY" as the README instructs

first_call.evidence: npx braintrust eval tutorial.eval.ts exited with TypeError: fetch failed caused by Error: read ECONNRESET

verified.evidence: Agent notes: No eval run could execute, so the promised outcome of scores being reported was not achieved

friction.detail: curl -s https://www.braintrust.dev/docs/llms.txt | grep -i "quickstart" returned no results, failing to surface the evaluation quickstart from the docs index.
Multiple fetch_url attempts to https://www.braintrust.dev/docs/start/evaluation-quickstart and similar returned no content, forcing the agent to find the GitHub README instead.

curl -v --ipv4 https://api.braintrust.dev/v1/project failed with curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer, and even curl -I https://www.google.com hit the same reset, causing cryptic ECONNRESET errors.
The README jumps straight to npx braintrust eval tutorial.eval.ts without a health-check step, making it unclear whether failures are auth, SDK, or network-related.

After hitting the network wall, the agent had to grep node_modules/braintrust/dist/ for offline, local, or apiUrl to look for a workaround, indicating the quickstart offers no guidance for restricted environments.
